intro_paragraphs: I'm an AI/ML researcher with an M.Sc. in Computer Engineering (Artificial Intelligence & Robotics), focused on deep learning for medical signal processing and applied IoT intelligence. My thesis used conditional GANs to strengthen ECG signal classifiers against adversarial attacks — work I'm continuing to publish and build on.

I've spent the last few years as a research engineer, teaching assistant, and contributor to the EU-funded Erasmus+ IoTrain project, moving between research, teaching, and cross-border collaboration. I'm always open to discussion, so feel free to reach out with any questions.
